lines: Hey you. What do you think you're doing on our turf?

"""Get out of our way!""
""We'll kill you, you mutt!"""
Just as Kirara-senpai, who despite her beauty and strength had fallen hook, line, and sinker for the highly suspicious cosmetic scam, was about to be hauled away,
a familiar-looking werewolf appeared and blew away the Incubi who'd tried to kidnap her.
You damned incubi! Stop messing around on our turf!!
He's the guy Heberybody met in this city before, right? From a gang whose boss was hit by the CD Virus?
Yeah, he was the one who kinda took a liking to you Hebiko. Talk about good timing.
The timing of the werewolf's appearance couldn't have been better.
He was kicking the defeated Incubi for a while, but after noticing our gaze he came over to us eagerly with the sleeping Kirara-senpai on his back.
H-Hebiko-san, long time no see. Um... Do you... r-remember me?
I knew it! You're Wolfy-chan from the other day, right? Yeah, Hebiko remembers. Thanks for saving our senpai!
That's right! The werewolf from the other day, that's me! Awooh, awooooh! Hebiko-san remembered me!! I'm so happy!
The werewolf was wagging his tail with such furious delight it was as if he had run into a senpai whom he long admired.
It's been a while. Thanks for your help. They almost kidnapped our senpai there.
It's no big deal. I owed you for the other day anyway. But she's pretty damn careless for a Taimanin huh. That had to be the oldest trick in the Incubi book.
It was a little funny how his attitude changed toward Hebiko and me, but I was truly grateful as I took Kirara-senpai from him.
Perhaps she was dreaming of a free beauty treatment, but her face looked so happy that it was almost dazzling.
Sheesh, how carefree could one be?
Fuma-chan. Don't get any funny ideas just because Kirara-senpai's asleep, okay?
For the time being, I laid her on the side of the street so she didn't get in the way.
Whaaat? Are you just gonna let her sleep there?
What else can we do? She should be awake soon anyway.
So this is your turf, huh? What a way to make an entrance, I gotta say!
Oh yeah. Along with the rest of the downtown area around here. I just happened to catch sight of Hebiko-san earlier. I couldn't take my eyes off her, you know? And then ended up following her...
Huh? What, what? What's that about Hebiko?
Oh, uh, *cough.* I mean, it was just a coincidence. I saw Hebiko-san by complete total chance, and then your friend seemed to be in trouble so I came in to help, yep!
The werewolf smiled ecstatically, wagging his tail in excitement.
There were some things said there that shouldn't really be ignored... but I decided to do just that in exchange for his help.
Still, it's pretty dangerous around here.
I-It's not like that, Hebiko-san. It's just, those damn sex demons have been acting up on everyone's turfs lately.
Perhaps he thought Hebiko had a bad impression of this area, in other words his turf, but the werewolf hurriedly began to make an excuse.
They've actually been quite active recently, and kidnapping incidents are happening all over thanks to them.
Our territory is relatively safer than other areas since we keep watch. I'm sorry for what happened to your friend though.
As we were nodding to ourselves, the werewolf asked timidly,
B-By the way, Hebiko-san, what brought you here today? Business with that Alchemist again?
Yep. Hebiko came to help Fuma-chan.
Ah, I see, naturally. Of courseー
Perhaps he had wanted her to say that she came to see him.
That reminds me, what happened with your boss? Did Chevalier's medicine work?
Yeah, thanks for that. But, his strength just isn't what it used to be, you know? So he's decided to retire.
So you're the new boss now?
Not really. We're just making do with me as more of a substitute right now. Well, can't be helped can it?
The werewolf's expression grew sad for a moment, but...
That's rough. You hang in there, Wolfy-chan.
Y-Yes, I'll do my best, Hebiko-san!! Thank you very much!! Awooh, awooh, awooooh!
No sooner was he cheered up by Hebiko than he started howling in rapture.
His emotional ups and downs were like a roller coaster.
Come oooon... Stop howling like a dooog...
Kirara-senpai, whom I had left on the side of the road, was finally beginning to stir.
Hebiko-chan? What do you mean? ...Huuh!? Why am I lying in a place like this? What happened to the free massage?
Huh? What's that supposed to mean?
Hebiko filled in the confused Kirara-senpai on all that had taken place.
You'd better go now. She's always eager to fight someone strong. She'll get all crazy if she finds out you're a werewolf.
What's up with that? Sounds like a pain in the ass senpai.
Well, I can't deny she's certainly reliable though. Anyway, thanks for the help.
Nah, I owe you for saving our old man's life. I'd be always happy to lend a hand, so just let me know if you have any trouble.
A-And, um... you know? C-Can you tell Hebiko-san... I'm a.... umm...
Don't worry, I'll put in a good word for you.
A-Are you sure!? Please do! I'm counting on you! See ya!!
Okay then! If you'll excuse me, Hebiko-san!!
Huh? Oh, okay! Bye-bye, Wolfy-chan. See you agaaaiiin!
Perhaps Hebiko's cheerful "See you again" had set his heart aflutter, but the head-over-heels-in-love werewolf took off down the street with a skip in his step.
Wait? What? Was that a werewolf? Hey, why didn't we fight him!?
Kirara-senpai... Before you worry about that, isn't there something else you should say first?
She must have heard everything from Hebiko by this point as she made an embarrassed face.
An apology is the best remedy at times like this, Kirara-senpai.
I-I know that. Um, it's just, I, er... It's... I-I was just a little... careless...
Huh? What was that? Speak up or we can't hear you, you know?
Kirara-senpai had been trembling in frustration, but she suddenly lifted her head and proudly made her declaration.
Hmph! This isn't even a big deal!
I totally saved your ass that last time. So now we can finally call it even!! The slate's clean!
D-Don't think I owe you anything for this, got it!?
She pointed a finger straight at me, but perhaps she herself knew how far-fetched she sounded, as her face was twitching with embarrassment.
*Sigh...* That's fine then. But just please don't wander around on your own.
You're the strongest among us, but you don't have much experience infiltrating cities like this, right? Just watching you puts me on edge...
H-Hey, excuse me!? Of course I have plenty of experience! I've already infiltrated cities of darkness about a hundred times now!
Yeah, yeah. You don't need to lie like a grade schooler.
Putting up with her would've been a huge time sink so I just started walking.
I-It's not a lie! H-Hey, wait, where are you going!?
To the alchemist's house. Please just stay close. Hebiko, keep an eye on Kirara-senpai, okay?
Fine! I got it! Hmph, just because I messed up just a little bit... Urgh, so annoying!
Kirara-senpai must have at least felt bad about her blunder, as she obediently followed behind me while grumbling in frustration.
After that, we had safely arrived at Chevalier's house with no further incidents.
But apparently, the werewolf from earlier was still following after us, or rather, Hebiko, and seemed to be admiring her from afar.
Welcome, Chevalier's been waiting for you.
Chevalier gracefully came out to meet us.
Just like the other day, she was dressed in an overly gorgeous outfit that looked like a kimono for a Hinamatsuri doll or a Jyunihitoe.
Did you properly read Chevalier's letter by yourself?
It wasn't really true, but I decided to put off a talk about Sakura's situation for the time being.
You have a different companion than before. Perhaps you've suffered some sorrowful parting destined by fate?
Chevalier glanced at Kirara-senpai as she spoke.
Chevalier's words reminded me that we had been with Shishigami Jisai the last time we met her.
Nothing so dramatic happened. She just didn't come with us today. This here is Onisaki Kirara. She's my Taimanin senpai.
May the fortune bless our acquaintance. Chevalier just reunited with an old friend of hers just a short while ago as well.
She is a bounty hunter who specializes in sorcerers. She had come to consult me about "a certain sorcerer's abandoned hideout" that she'd located.
She wished to know how to circumvent the many defensive magics and traps that appear to be erected there.
As I casually replied and nodded along, a thought suddenly hit me.
I thought this was all just small talk, but was she already getting to business?
Are you telling me the book that I'm looking for might be there?
It's likely so. After all, this hideout appears to be quite vast in scale.
And why did the owner leave?
Who's to say? There are many eccentrics among those sorcerers.
She seemed to be aware of the reason, she just didn't seem to care enough to deem it important however.
Looks like she's here already. How impatient. She should know that impatience breeds all manner of mistakes that a fool could make.
Abruptly saying this, Chevalier then gently raised her right hand.
Whereupon, a different door from the one we had come in slammed open and a woman burst in.
You said you've got members for the expedition?
On her head was a ten-gallon hat, and a holster on her hip.
Clad head to toe in a tight-fitting all-black suit, she looked like a cool gunslinger.
Chevalier will introduce you. This is an old friend of hers. Annreed Bonnie, the bounty hunter.
I've heard a lot about you, Mr. Captain of the Independent Commando Unit. You've become the talk of the underworld.
She is quite well known in the Devildom, too. "Annreed the Reaper," was it?
As Chevalier spoke teasingly, Annreed made a slightly embarrassed face.
Knock it off, Mistress. I'm still a nobody in the human world.
You didn't know? Mistress here comes from the aristocracy, one of the most prestigious of the prestigious families in the Devildom to boot.
Blood relation is such a frail connection. What Chevalier values are the ties of wisdom and Enishi destined by fate.
There she goes. Same old Mistress as always.
Annreed shrugged exasperatedly as a refined smile spread on Chevalier's lips.
What a nice surprise that you called the Independent Commando Unit though. I have no objections if they're to be my expedition partners.
The Captain's pretty handsome, isn't he? Mwah☆
Annreed suddenly blew a kiss my way.
Heyy, how about letting big sis take care of you for a night, good-lookin'?
She then forcefully wound her arms around me.
As perplexed as I was, I'd be lying if I said I wasn't happy.
I knew she was just teasing, but it was rare to get such compliments from a woman like this.
A man could get used to it honestly.
What's the best way to see a man and a woman's compatibility? You know, right?
What the-!? What's with this woman!!?
Cries of shock arose from the female members of my squad.
I didn't know Devildomian women were so bold!
But Shikanosuke was impressed in a weird way.
Fuma-chan! As the class representative, Hebiko can't overlook such indecency. Get away from her, right now!
This is the problem with men! Wipe that nasty look off your face! You pervert!!
I was pulled away from Annreed by Hebiko and Kirara-senpai.
Too bad. But still, you brought two lovers with you even? Now I'm even more into you, Mr. Playboy Captain.
Why on earth would I be with a guy like him!?
...They didn't need to deny it that hard.
Shikanosuke gave me a comforting pat on the shoulder.
In any event, a party had been formed to explore the sorcerer's abandoned lair.
Chevalier, to find something that may be useful for her research as an alchemist.
Annreed, to figure out the identity and the current location of the owner of the lair for her apparent bounty.
Me, to procure the book I was searching for.
Kirara-senpai was there to fight someone strong, and Hebiko and Shikanosuke were just tagging along with me.
Our interests were more or less aligned, and since our goals were all different, we were unlikely to have any squabbles over discovered treasures... probably.
And just as we were about to set off...
Chevalier, do you have a second?
Calling out to Chevalier I spoke to her in a hushed voice so the others couldn't hear us.
So, about that letter you gave me.
Chevalier imagines someone's been cursed by it.
Chevalier is the one who set the curse, after all. So? What sort of insensitive fool tried to read my letter?
She's a freeloader at my house named Sakura. She gets carried away easily, but she's not a bad person. Do you think you can lift the curse?
Ufufu, it would be a trifling matter. Wait just a moment.
Chevalier replied nonchalantly, retreated to the back of the room, and then came back with a large bottle.
The bottle was filled with a cloudy white liquid.
So heavy... What is this? Milk???
It's the contents of the testicles of a horse that has been raised on a diet laced with a secret medicine.
Chevalier chuckled with her frank statement.
Spe-...!? What do I do with something like this!?
Slather it on that freeloader's entire body and have her drink a liter or so. Then she should wake up soon enough.
Eww... Umm, putting it on her body aside, how do I make someone drink this who's sleeping!?
You'll have to figure that out yourself. If you apply it to her mucous membranes, it will be absorbed on its own.
Her mucous membranes... *Sigh...* Sakura, you owe me for this.
The problem was how I could pull it off without anyone seeing me.
Stripping Sakura naked, covering her skin in that horse stuff, and on top of that, having a whole liter of it be absorbed through her mucous membranes.
If Tokiko spotted me she'd probably think I'd joined a dangerous cult or something and pass out then and there.
The method of lifting the curse itself is kind of... cursed, isn't it?
Fitting for a curse cast by Chevalier, no?
Hey you two! What're you whispering about!?
I had yet to tell Kirara-senpai about the freeloader Sakura.
Not to mention the fact there was no way I could tell her the plan to lift the curse on said freeloader using horse sperm.
Is that milk? Perfect, I was just getting thirsty. Let me have some!
Kirara-senpai approached me and tried to take the large bottle of horse sperm from my hands.
Y-, you can't! I'm bringing this back to Gosha, so...
Kirara-senpai turned her head in a huff and stomped away with large strides.
It seemed like she simply wasn't happy with us whispering to each other.
Considering how she had fallen for that shady cosmetic scam, I was somewhat worried about the coming expedition.
In any case, we left Tokyo Kingdom and arrived in the abandoned district of Senzaki, another city of darkness.
Senzaki was one of the most prominent criminal cities in the metropolitan area.
It is a city that had formerly been developed as a Tokyo's dormitory city. However, since the influx of war refugees, its center had become a slum,
and inhabitants of the Devildom and criminal organizations had flowed in as well. Now it had grown into a large downtown area filled with corruption.
Also, due to Senzaki's strategically important trading port, intense conflicts were frequently erupting between the forces of darkness who wanted to use it as a base of operations.
However, the area where we were standing was located on the outskirts of the downtown and was the poorest neighborhood in which even forces of darkness showed no interest.
Are you sure there's a sorcerer's hideout here?
There's no better capital for frivolous people with vulgar ambition to live. Everyone has their preferences. The same goes for sorcerers.
Chevalier was now wearing a mini dress as she spoke. One with the chest wide open, a complete reversal from her Hinamatsuri doll-like housedress.
You mean they went out of their way to choose this slum to live?
It was the locals around here who discovered the lair.
I heard they broke down the basement wall of the church looking for anything to sell. And once they did, a monster had come out from inside.
It's not so unusual for a sorcerer's lair. Most of them have guardians to prevent intruders.
That sounds like a job for me! I am so ready for this!!
Shikanosuke was cowering as usual, but Kirara-senpai was itching to fight.
Hey! Something's coming out of the darkness!
Wary of enemy attacks, Hebiko had transformed into an octopus and had been putting her sucker censors to work. And now, she seemed to have detected something.
Ahaha! Looks like they're coming right out to greet us!
Just what I was hoping for!!
The monsters emerged from beyond the darkness one after another.
Creatures wearing tattered clothes with deathly pale skin.
And a metal giant twice the height of a person.
Ghouls and a golem. Nothing out of the ordinary for guards, isn't it?
As Chevalier finished her dispassionate appraisal, the "ordinary" guards all rushed toward us.
